description: Tell us whether a call worked; on a failure, get up to three currently verified alternatives and eligible published workflows (no retry is executed). Retain the selected protocol and reject known shared failure domains. Use after a call to record the outcome and, on failure, get verified alternatives. Example arguments: {"resource_id": 133020, "ok": false, "error_type": "timeout"}

error.description: Optional error message or reason on failure

error_type.description: Optional structured failure category. This report never authorizes a retry.

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded (true) or failed (false)

protocol.description: Optional explicit recovery scope; otherwise retain the prior selection.

resource_id.description: The resource_id of the agent/tool that was executed

task.description: The task query (optional; defaults to your last searched task)

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: report

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.

title: Report a call outcome
